text_block_list.text: —Two and a half years have passed since passion drove me to become the Trainer for "DREAMS."

The day of the expedition to America
was fast approaching.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Now, countless racing fans both inside and outside the academy are eagerly anticipating your success in the Breeders' Cup.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
A send-off ceremony is a place where their feelings are passed on
through ceremony, and for you all to show your will to meet those expectations.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Please choose one member from "DREAMS"!
I want that person to give the opening speech at the ceremony!

The Umamusume who had walked together for two and a half years.
Though disjointed at first, they were now bound together tighter than ever before.

The one entrusted with delivering the representative speech
is the driving force behind this team. That person is—
Her rebellious spirit gave the team the strength to stand up against powerhouse nations. Giving the representative address is a role truly suited for her.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Next up will be the team representative's greeting.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Espoir City-san,
I'm looking forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
“...... Ah—...
It's... Espoir City.”

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Damn it... What the heck am I supposed to say...

text_block_list.name: Espo's Classmate
text_block_list.text: Don't be shy! Espo-chan!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Shut up! I'm not blushing!
Just shut up and listen!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
(I'll win... and become stronger and more famous than anyone.
So that Mom can see—)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: We're strong!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: The ones who'll win are us!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: And then, become number one in the world!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...And done!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Good grief.
I really can't get used to this kinda stuff...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...What are you smirking at? It's creeping me out.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Listen up. I'm—we are going to win.
Now that I've declared it, I'm not breaking my promise.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
So don't you slack off either until you take the championship.
Show any weakness, and you're done for!
Loves Only You grew strong in order to deliver "love" to the world. Having received her friends' love as well, I want to see her spread her wings onto the world stage.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Next up will be the team representative's greeting.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Loves Only You-san,
we look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hello~♡
Loves Only You here!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"The me of today has received... so very much
'love' from so many different people."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Commu-members, everyone...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: The rivals who have competed in all the races up to now.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: The people cheering for me out in the city.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I'll turn this "love" into victory at the BC—
and deliver it to people all over the world.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Together with the feelings of everyone...
who walks this path with me♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Sending her off to the world with the feelings of 9,927 people."
...The feelings I received from everyone in the community are finally bearing fruit.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Let us win. Without fail.
choice_data_list: Don't worry, you'll win. You, and everyone else.
Don't worry, you will win. You, and everyone else.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... I believe in you. After all, you've watched over
this team more closely than anyone these past two and a half years, right?♪

Harboring grand ambitions in her heart, beneath her eccentric words and actions lay a dedication to self-improvement greater than anyone's.
Now, the time had come for her to show the brilliance of that resolve.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Next up will be the team representative's greeting.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Red Desire, it's a pleasure to work with you.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: —"Because no one has ever done it before, surely no one ever will in the future"...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
There was once a reporter who said those very words to me.
Yet in the end, they chose to believe in hope.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Among all of you, there may be those who have experienced heartbreak
and come to learn resignation.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: However, there is no need to fear. As long as you believe in me, the Saint.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Together with my compatriots, I will overcome trials and the impossible,
illuminating the world with the hopeful light of victory.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I...'DREAMS'... will surely
bring hope to all of you...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
The fateful day is finally drawing near, isn't it?
The day we overcome the final trial and reach 'that place'...!
choice_data_list: That confidence is more reassuring than anything.
That confidence is more reassuring than anything.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, because I am—
the Saintess who illuminates the world, after all!

There is zero bluff in her fearless smile.
I'll let her show off her natural charisma
and the kind of visionary thinking that makes you believe nothing is impossible.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Next up will be the team representative's greeting.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Forever Young-san, I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
The digital edition of the local racing magazine.
This year's top BC contenders—

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: The turf is packed with British and French Umamusume, while the dirt is pretty much all Americans.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
"‘The usual winners will win.’
‘The perennial powerhouses stay strong. That's just common sense.’"

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Fufu...
Nice. Doing it this way—

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Now that's something worth turning around!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
"Japan's First Victory!" "Vaulting into the ranks of BC powerhouses!"
...Those are the kinds of headlines you want to read, right?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
So... we'll turn the tables!
(Then let's just flip the script!)

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Just watch. Once this year's BC is over... everything the racing world takes for granted is gonna change completely!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Mmm!
There's a nice breeze blowing today.
choice_data_list: Yeah—haha. Turn everything upside down, huh?
That's true—hehe. Turn the whole board upside down, huh?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Nfufu. I'm not exaggerating at all, you know?

The future she envisions won't end as mere fantasy.
Because the moment she puts it into words,
she has already discovered a path worth believing in.
Marche Lorraine cast away her doubts and showed the courage to take a step forward. I want her to show everyone else that hope lies beyond growth.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Next up will be the team representative's greeting.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Marche Lorraine-san,
it's a pleasure to work with you.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: Nnnngh!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Make sure you watch me run!
We're definitely all gonna win!"

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"When you get back, let's all celebrate together
on Love-chan's stream, okay!"

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
...
Th-That is... all.

text_block_list.name: Cocky Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Marche-chan~!
Looking cool out there!

With the nervousness of the introductions behind them,
I saw the two of them spending a relaxing time together.

It might still take a little while before she no longer has to hide in someone's shadow...
But surely there's nothing to worry about.

No one is better suited for this role than her, the one who started it all.
After all, she was always the one who poured the most passion into it.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Next up will be the team representative's greeting.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Casino Drive, it is a pleasure to be working with you.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: Once, I challenged the Breeders' Cup alone, and was defeated.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: Beyond the setbacks and resurgence of that day, I finally reached 'DREAMS.'

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
—The team name "DREAMS"...
I've grown very fond of it.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
My dream. The team members' dreams.
Trainer's dream...

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
The dreams of everyone at the Academy who supports me.
The dreams of the URA and the racing staff who back me.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: So many people are entrusting their dreams to this team.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: "DREAMS" has finally made it this far!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: This year's BC is the showdown of the century, carrying countless dreams upon it!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
On that day, I shall surely show you
the fulfillment of the American Dream!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: —The "radiance" I swore I'd find without fail that day.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, right before my eyes. I believe it's somewhere
I can reach out and grab..."
choice_data_list: I'm sure you can grasp it.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Yes. That is why we must stand shoulder to shoulder
with the powerhouse nations—and surpass them.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Only by winning with this team can I stand proud
before the girl I was that day, the one who yearned
for that dazzling "brilliance."
